synthesis_points: Draft exact precondition card templates for baseline, reference state, expected output, source-to-claim rows, term manifests, B_Psi, V(Psi), residual tolerance, switch leakage, and gate verdict carry.
Preserve not_run and no_result locks across all templates.
Reject result-bearing synonyms including pass, success, validated, verified, confirmed, recovered, safe, closed, resolved, fixture-ready, physics-ready, and canon-ready.
Use held, blocked, schema-only, scaffold-only, lint-refused, not_evaluated, and OPEN_NOT_TESTED instead.
Treat row identity, normalized keys, provenance triples, witness bundles, null semantics, refusal vocabulary, comparison leakage, and authority conflicts as claim-envelope fields.
Keep B_Psi quarantined or demoted until separately defined.
Keep V(Psi) symbolic until potential and derivative rules exist.
Keep Journey/Solas as journey_context_not_canon if used, with local path and line references.
CLI local read blocker remains relevant for repository-grounded CLI verification, but prompt-bounded CLI advisories can still contribute abstract schema rules.
v6_x2 should synthesize a consolidated claim-envelope schema and no-execution lint-harness plan.
